description: Single shared uint32 counter with fixed atomicAdd, atomicCAS or atomicMin attempts. CAS includes a value-preserving atomic read per attempt and one success-count store per thread; min retains zero. Raw times and attempted-work counts are emitted; actual results are verified.

scaling_param.name: ops_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of selected atomic attempts per thread; CAS additionally performs one atomic read per attempt.

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid

non_scaling_params.name: atomic_op
non_scaling_params.description: Type of atomic operation to benchmark

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
